Dar all,
What are those points and those "error-bars" showed in
itemfitplot(...,empirical.plot) command?


Best,

Caio

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: itemfit
parts:
These represent the estimated (read: potentially quite bias) confidence intervals around the grouped point estimates, which themselves represent the proportion of collapsed individual frequencies based on secondary latent trait estimates. If you think that's a mouthful, it is. See the reference for Yen in the helpfile, as well as some later work by Chen & Thissen, and myself & Ng.

 

Phil
